description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'BaseEntityData' implementing 'EntityData' interface, providing data management for entities including attributes, timestamps, owner info, and entity fields, with methods for data access and manipulation.

classes.name: BaseEntityData
classes.description: An abstract class managing entity data including attributes, timestamps, owner info, and entity fields, with methods for data access, modification, and comparison.

methods.name: getAttr
methods.description: Retrieves attribute data point based on key ID and entity key type.

methods.name: putAttr
methods.description: Stores an attribute data point with specified key ID and scope.

methods.name: removeAttr
methods.description: Removes an attribute data point by key ID and scope.

methods.name: getTs
methods.description: Retrieves timestamp data point by key ID.

methods.name: putTs
methods.description: Stores a timestamp data point with specified key ID.

methods.name: removeTs
methods.description: Removes timestamp data point by key ID.

methods.name: getOwnerName
methods.description: Returns the owner entity name based on customer ID and tenant info.

methods.name: getDataPoint
methods.description: Retrieves data point based on data key and query context.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Retrieves specific entity field data based on key.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Retrieves entity field value as string by name.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Generates display name based on entity type and fields.

methods.name: isTenantEntity
methods.description: Checks if the entity belongs to a tenant.

methods.name: getRelatedParentId
methods.description: Gets related parent ID from query context.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns entity type (null in base class).

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if entity fields are null.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on entity ID.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on entity ID.
